subject: ClearPay onboarding: model recommendations, context needs, and traffic snapshot
messages:
From: Sarah Liu <sarah@clearpay.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-05T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro — ClearPay pilot details

Hi Monica,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Per our conversation, I promised to send a brief snapshot of our expected usage so your team can propose a model shortlist and any obvious constraints. High level:

- Product: customer support triage + automated response drafts (short emails, 1–3 bullets) and an internal summarization endpoint for escalations.
- Peak concurrency: ~40 concurrent users during business hours (US PST).
- Estimated tokens per interaction: avg 320 (prompt + response), 90th pct ~1,100 for complex escalations.
- Daily active users: 1,200 (expected first 3 months), expect 30% month-over-month growth through pilot.

I've attached the traffic snapshot (CSV + small examples) — see clearpay_traffic_snapshot.xlsx.

Primary ask: can your team recommend 2–3 model candidates with suggested context length and a back-of-envelope token-cost estimate so we can include in the internal procurement memo?

CCing Tim (ops) for any infra questions.

Best,
Sarah
Sarah Liu
Head of Platform
ClearPay

Attachments: clearpay_traffic_snapshot.xlsx (table + sample payloads)

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Liu <sarah@clearpay.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-05T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro — ClearPay pilot details

Hi Sarah — thanks for the numbers, this is exactly what we need. Quick confirmation items while our implementation team reviews the spreadsheet:

1) For the 90th pct ~1,100 tokens, is that mostly due to long customer history pasted in, or verbose agent notes? If it's history-heavy we should consider prefix caching.
2) Any PII restrictions (SSN, payment tokens) we should flag in the onboarding checklist?
3) Target latency SLO for generation (p95) — is 800ms acceptable for triage suggestions, or do you need lower?

Next steps from Redwood: Vivek and Jordan will take the traffic snapshot, produce a 2-page model recommendation (shortlist + context length), and a rough cost-per-1k-token estimate for hosted vs dedicated. We'll aim to get that to you by EOD Oct 6.

I'll attach an internal CS->Impl checklist in the next mail so nothing falls through the cracks.

— Monica
Monica Patel
Account Lead, Mid-Market
Redwood Inference

Attachments: cs-implementation-checklist.pdf (internal checklist template)

From: Timothy O'Neill <tim@clearpay.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Sarah Liu <sarah@clearpay.com>
Date: 2026-10-06T08:09:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro — ClearPay pilot details

Monica — quick answers to your questions:

- The long tails come from customer history (previous messages) plus occasional pasted receipts. We can strip account numbers and token-type sensitive strings before sending, but we'd prefer Redwood's guidance on PII handling for quicker cycles.
- Latency: 800ms p95 is a soft target for triage suggestions. For escalation summaries, we can tolerate up to 1.5s.
- Compliance: we need SOC2 controls and explicit audit logs for any model calls tied to support tickets.

Thanks,
Tim
Tim O'Neill
Director, Ops
ClearPay

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-06T12:17:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: ClearPay onboarding — model shortlist request

Forwarding Sarah/Tim's snapshot — key asks at top for the handoff:

- Workload: triage + draft responses + escalation summaries (avg 320 tokens, 90th 1,100). Peak conc 40.
- Targets: ~800ms p95 triage, 1.5s escalation summaries. SOC2 + audit logs required.
- Deliverable: 2–3 candidate models, suggested context windows, quantization/throughput tradeoffs, and a back-of-envelope cost delta hosted vs dedicated.

My quick read (for your queue):
- Candidate A: opt-6b q4_0 or higher, context 2,048 — best latency/cost for short replies.
- Candidate B: opt-13b int8, context 4,096 — better for 90th percentile escalations; verify 4k KV cache behavior.
- Candidate C: llama2-13b-v2 (float16) or equivalent — highest quality for summarization, consider dedicated for consistent tail latency.

Please produce:
1) A short memo (single page) with recommended primary model and fallback.
2) Token-cost ballpark: cost per 1k tokens and expected monthly spend for months 0–3 based on Sarah's numbers.
3) Any immediate risks/unknowns (PII handling, cache efficiency, ops needs).

I've attached initial_model_shortlist.md with my notes. Put the memo in the drive link and reply-all.

— Monica

Attachments: initial_model_shortlist.md

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Sarah Liu <sarah@clearpay.com>
Date: 2026-10-07T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: ClearPay onboarding — model shortlist request

Thanks for the context. I've pulled the traffic snapshot and sketched a technical recommendation below — attaching a one-page memo to the Drive. Quick summary:

Recommendation (primary + fallback):
- Primary: opt-6.7b (q4_0) — context 2,048. Rationale: cheap units, small kv-cache, consistent sub-800ms p95 on our hosted fleet with batching tuned for 40 concurrent users. Good for triage/draft.
- Fallback (tail-heavy escalations): llama-13b-v2 (float16) — context 4,096 (dedicated preferred). Rationale: preserves quality at 90th token lengths and better summarization.

Cost estimates (very rough):
- Based on Sarah's 1,200 DAU, avg 320 tokens per interaction, 3 interactions per day per user (pilot): ~1,152,000 tokens/day => ~34.6M tokens/month.
- Hosted (mixed): ~ $0.21 / 1k tokens (weighted) => ~$7.3k/month.
- Dedicated (reservation + lower per-token): ~ $5.5k/month (with baseline reserved capacity at 1x node + burst) — depends on quantization choice and caching hit-rate.

Operational notes / unknowns:
- PII: implement server-side scrubbing pre-inference + redact logs. Provide an audit-log shim that surfaces call metadata without payloads for SOC2.
- Cache: prefix caching expected to hit ~55% for repetitive prompts; we need sample payloads to validate.
- Latency: will require tuning batching window to hit ~800ms p95 — I recommend a short canary with 2 nodes dedicated for 2 weeks.

Next actions:
1) Sarah / Tim: confirm sample payloads (anonymized) for cache-hit analysis.
2) Monica / Jordan: I can draft the single-page memo with the numbers above and upload to Drive by EOD Oct 7.
3) Schedule 30-min technical handoff (I propose Oct 9, 9am PST).

Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Principal Engineer, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: one-page_memo_clearpay.pdf (in Drive)
